Nirsa men avaidh koyla khanan ka mamla ek bar phir charcha men hai. raja koliyri men sanchalit avaidh khanan ke muhanon ka nirikshan karne pahunche vidhayak arup chatarji ne koyla chori ke bare netvark aur suraksha vyavastha par saval uthae hain. unhonne sthiti ko dekhkar narajgi jataee aur khanan gatividhiyon par tatkal rok lagane ki mang ki.
